subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: Should outbound delivery expose runId plus bounded transcript/tool-call/result evidence to pre-send plugin hooks, and under what permission, redaction, and failure semantics?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent API changes public Plugin SDK fields and could expose sensitive session/tool data or imply fail-closed enforcement that current hooks do not provide.

options.title: Design bounded evidence contract
options.body: Define a versioned additive hook context or evidence object with explicit permissions, redaction, limits, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Route evidence through turn-end API
options.body: Keep outbound hooks payload-only and satisfy tool-call/result access through the broader typed turn outcome contract instead.

options.title: Keep hooks advisory
options.body: Document that current pre-send hooks can rewrite/cancel text but are not a deterministic verification boundary for tool claims.

recommendation.title: Design bounded evidence contract
recommendation.body: Define a versioned additive hook context or evidence object with explicit permissions, redaction, limits, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a public plugin hook/API contract decision, and this handle is most directly tied to recent hook correlation history.
